Outcome: implement and compare component-level assessment, explicit entity/event bindings, incompatibility-specific counterevidence, and automatic frame-specific descriptions with tracking proposals. User explicitly authorized items1–4. Preserve fixed parent claims, source scope, original results and failures. Parent accuracy issue bd-01M5EA1JDF877X4RZPJY6EFJDJ remains open. Experimental tooling and native receipts, no production promotion or publication.

Scope: generate/freeze component questions without source/reference labels, validate extraction completeness independently, compare new protocol against current DeepSeek on identical focal AV and optional manual evidence. Separately generate question-independent per-frame visual facts and conservative explicit track proposals, compare automatic-only source inputs. Keep original56 parent denominator, component coverage and whole-claim truth separate, and forbid cross-component support/counter from becoming same-component conflict. Positive contradiction requires actual same-entity/event incompatibility. All media/recall/source artifacts stay ignored.

Acceptance: discriminating synthetic falsifiers; fixed-pair developer comparison with input references frozen before assessment; retain all extraction/transport/protocol failures; native ownership receipts; independent exact-SHA and semantic outcome review. Local pinned vision model; new remote call batch conservatively bounded atUSD5, stop on rate limits with safe metadata retained. Parent scientific accuracy requires future held-out evaluation. No merge/push.
set.title: Assess memory components with explicit joins and frame-specific evidence
